dedupe_keys.name: japan municipal and hourly energy supply demand database

description: The Japan Energy Database team publishes harmonized energy supply and demand estimates for all 1,741 Japanese municipalities. The Zenodo description identifies national energy-balance and renewable inputs, sectoral consumption and hourly estimates to support local energy analysis. The release lists a data ZIP, README and documentation. Access is free under CC BY-NC 4.0, which restricts commercial reuse. These tables can supply municipal loads and resource contexts for local energy-system simulations, with model-pypsa a related modelling platform. A caveat is that hourly municipal profiles are estimates assembled from national sources, not direct meters for every locality. Administrative boundaries, sector definitions and base years need checking before combining with network models. The repository metadata and file manifest were read, but the ZIP and documentation contents were not downloaded; no row-level validation was performed.
